evidence.text: [Imagery] Crunchd brand identity requires the use of film grain texture for all designs in the 'TikTok cover frames: snack audit series' project, which received final approval from Jess Okafor on 2025-05-09.

[Colour] Crunchd brand identity requires muted tones; as of 2026-04-13, bright yellow backgrounds like #FFE500 are prohibited for being too intense, and designs must use a muted butter yellow instead. This follows the existing requirement that designs must use an oat or pastel base and avoid dark backgrounds.

[Imagery] Crunchd brand identity requires an imperfect, authentic aesthetic, rejecting overly styled studio flat-lays; as of 2025-11-13, this includes a requirement for real hands, chipped nail polish, and a messy desk. As of 2025-11-17, this also includes a requirement for a warm faded grade, as approved for the 'Holiday gift box post'. As of 2026-02-09, this requirement for a warm faded grade is mandatory for all imagery to ensure it matches the pastel colour palette, following the rejection of a fully saturated creator photo. This requirement was further validated on 2026-02-11 when Jess Okafor approved the 'Creator collab announcement' post for its warm and faded photo grading.

[Colour] Crunchd brand identity requires high-visibility background colours for out-of-home settings; as of 2025-07-14, the 'Brooklyn bus shelter poster' project must use a peach background, as lilac was rejected for washing out at a distance. This design received final approval from Theo Lindqvist on 2025-07-17.
[Imagery] Crunchd brand identity requires a 'soft' and 'muted' aesthetic, specifically using muted tones.
[Colour] Crunchd brand identity prohibits the use of neon colors, as they are considered to cheapen the brand.

[Layout] Crunchd brand identity requires that designs clearly communicate the product being sold, avoiding excessive minimalism that obscures the product identity; additionally, designs must avoid clutter and limit the amount of text used. As of 2025-07-14, this includes a specific requirement for the 'Brooklyn bus shelter poster' project that each poster must feature only one hero flavour with the flavour name displayed clearly and prominently, replacing the previous requirement of one flavour and one bag. This supersedes the earlier rejection of designs with multiple flavour names and multiple bags.
[Colour] Crunchd brand identity utilizes a Peach (#F2C4A8) background for the Smoky Maple flavour launch.
[Imagery] Crunchd brand identity allows the use of one emoji per slide in carousel-style design assets, as approved for the 'Carousel: ingredients we don't use' project on 2025-09-12.

[Compliance] Crunchd brand identity requires that designs avoid blending in with other content, as Theo Lindqvist expressed concern on 2026-04-17 that the current design direction is becoming too generic.
[Copy] Crunchd brand identity requires the inclusion of flavour names on all product-related design assets to ensure public understanding of the product.
[Layout] Crunchd brand identity requires product shots to be positioned off-center to avoid a catalog-like appearance.
